description: Analyse decoupling: the cost versus benefit of transferring one co-owner's share so a borrower is freed up for another purchase (including stamp duty).

buyer.description: The co-owner buying out the share and refinancing.

age.description: Buyer's age in years; limits the loan tenure (age plus tenure at most 65), the LTV tier and, on a leasehold, the CPF usable.

citizenship.description: Buyer's residency status; sets the ABSD on taking over the share and in the comparison `options`.

cpfInOA.description: Buyer's CPF Ordinary Account balance available for the downpayment, in SGD.

financingPercent.description: Loan-to-value percentage to borrow against the seller's share: 75 and 55 are first-housing-loan tiers, 45 and 25 second-loan tiers. It can only lower what the buyer's age and tenure allow; omit to use the highest allowed.

legalFees.description: Buyer's conveyancing fees, in SGD; part of the buyer's cash required.

loanInterestRate.description: Annual rate assumed for the buyer's new loan, as a percentage (e.g. 2.6 = 2.6%); sets the monthly instalment.

remainingLeaseYears.description: Remaining lease on the property, in years; caps the loan tenure and, when short, the CPF the buyer may use. Omit for freehold.

newPropertyPrice.description: Price of a subsequent property purchase the freed-up buyer plans, in SGD.

outstandingLoan.description: Loan still owed on the whole property, in SGD; split between the parties by share.

seller.description: The co-owner transferring out their share.

citizenship.description: Seller's residency status; sets their ABSD rate in the purchase comparison `options`.

cpfUsageInterest.description: CPF the seller used on the property plus accrued interest, in SGD; refunded to their CPF out of the seller's proceeds.

legalFees.description: Seller's conveyancing fees, in SGD; deducted from the seller's proceeds.

sellerStampDuty.description: Seller's Stamp Duty on the transfer, in SGD; deducted from the seller's proceeds.

shares.description: Seller's ownership share, in percent, which the buyer takes over. The buyer already holds the rest.

valuation.description: Current market value of the whole property, in SGD; each party's share is valued pro rata.

name: analyze_decoupling

buyer.description: The buyer's financing of the share.

cashRequired.description: Downpayment on the share left for cash after CPF, in SGD.

loanForSellerShares.description: New loan to buy the seller's share, in SGD.

loanForSellerSharesLtvPercent.description: LTV applied to that new loan, in percent (75 = 75%).

maxCpfUsage.description: CPF the buyer may use towards the share, in SGD.

maxLoanFromBank.description: Total loan: refinanced plus new, in SGD.

refinancedLoan.description: Buyer's own share of the outstanding loan, refinanced, in SGD.

absd.description: Additional Buyer’s Stamp Duty on the share, in SGD.

absdRate.description: ABSD rate applied, as a decimal fraction (0.2 = 20%).

bsd.description: Buyer's Stamp Duty on the transferred share, in SGD.

bsdLabel.description: Short label of the BSD formula applied.

depositPercent.description: Minimum cash deposit as a percentage of the share value (5 = 5%).

options.description: Stamp-duty comparison for the next purchase when newPropertyPrice is given, else empty. Options 1-3 buy without decoupling (jointly, seller alone, buyer alone); options 4-5 decouple first, either way round.

value.description: Formatted value: an SGD amount or a citizenship code.

total.description: Total of stamp duties, legal fees and (when decoupling) SSD, in SGD.

seller.description: The seller's side of the transfer.

cashProceed.description: Value of the share less loan, CPF refund, SSD and legal fees, in SGD.

cpfUsageInterest.description: CPF refunded to the seller’s account, in SGD.

outstandingLoan.description: Seller's share of the outstanding loan, in SGD.

sellerStampDuty.description: Seller's Stamp Duty paid, in SGD.

valuation.description: Value of the seller's share, in SGD.

stages.description: How the transfer is paid out.

cashDisbursed.description: Cash payable beyond the deposit, in SGD.

cpfDisbursed.description: CPF paid towards the share, in SGD.

loanMonthly.description: Monthly instalment on the total loan over maxTenureYears, in SGD.

buyerCashRequired.description: Cash the buyer must find: cash downpayment on the share, BSD, ABSD and legal fees, in SGD.

sellerCashProceed.description: Cash the seller walks away with, in SGD.

title: Decoupling analysis
